newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian cereals imports rose 8.6 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Italian cereals imports rose 8.6 pct in 1996.

text.p: Italian imports of cereals in 1996 rose to 10.08 million tonnes from 9.28 million in 1995 while exports totalled 3.49 million tonnes against 3.33 million, the national cereals association said in a statement.

According to provisional data, 1996 imports of soft wheat rose by 505,000 tonnes to 4.97 million tonnes, mainly due to increased imports from France and Britain. Imports of durum wheat were up 182,000 tonnes to 1.21 million, mainly due to increased imports from France and Spain.
Rice imports were 20,000 tonnes lower at 55,835 tonnes.
On exports, sales of soft wheat flour rose 34 percent to 850,166 tonnes mainly due to increased exports to Algeria, Georgia, Yemen and Albania.
Pasta exports rose 15 percent to 1.12 million tonnes, a new record, the cereals association said.
Rice exports were 5.6 percent lower at 607,593 tonnes.
In value terms, Italy's cereals imports totalled 3.885 trillion lire against 3.657 trillion in 1995 while exports were valued at 3.112 trillion lire against 2.815 trillion.
